children: Russia's Autostat, citing data from its partner, consulting company PPK, said:
Car sales in Russia fell 6.5% year-on-year in August to 114,285 units.
Sales of Russia's largest carmaker, Avtovaz, decreased by 2.0% to 27,061 cars, it added.
